ops.title: cc-pool v0.53.0 shipped the origin-owned credential-sync redesign; both Macs migrated live; fleet-state facts + pending logins
ops.body:
The cross-host credential-sync logout bug is FIXED and SHIPPED as **cc-pool v0.53.0** (2026-07-13, main `dcf6a2e7`, tag pushed → tap published). Root cause was the shipped holder/lease/lineage design keeping BOTH Macs on one shared single-use refresh-token chain → double-spend → `invalid_grant` → tombstone → "Not logged in". Replaced by the **origin-owned model**: one origin host per chain refreshes it; peers hold access-token-only blobs (refresh token STRIPPED before crossing the mesh — structural, not a gate); ownership = refresh-token presence; owned blobs never overwritten by sync. Design rationale in ccn doc `4dce1ad` (supersedes `10bf17d`). The v0.53.0 branch also merged the user's mid-flight Holder-v2/session-lease work off main (clean, validated).

**Live migration DONE across both Macs** (yBook-Pro = `yasyf@yasyf.tail71af5d.ts.net`, origin-majority; yasyf-home = `yasyf@yasyf-home.tail71af5d.ts.net`, Tailscale SSH, both directions non-interactive). Both on v0.53.0 CLI+daemon; store schema migration (drop cred_hash/cred_parent_hash, add auth_health.kind) validated on real DBs; sync re-enabled origin-first; **5 accounts that were missing on yasyf-home materialized with working synced creds** (Yasyf-5/6/7/8/9 + the real Aneta); ZERO invalid_grant/double-spend/collateral logouts during migration.

**Pending (user must do — interactive browser OAuth, can't automate):** `ccp login` for **UCSF** (dead on BOTH Macs, no live copy anywhere) and, on yasyf-home, **rebecccafang / rebeccafang_2005 / Yasyf-3** (dead there; this Mac holds live copies so they may auto-heal on the daemon cycle, else re-login on the owning Mac).

**Durable data fact — yasyf-home has a PRE-EXISTING duplicate (not from the migration):** acct-02 and acct-03 BOTH hold uuid `5dc33419` (`yasyfm@gmail.com`); acct-03 is mislabeled "Aneta". The real Aneta is uuid `017db4f6`/`yasyf@aneta.company` (materialized as acct-15). Offered to remove the stale dup (acct-03); awaiting user. The sync teardown's uuid-dupe guard handles it fail-closed.

Follow-on in flight: user asked to remove ALL back-compat/migration/legacy-version cruft from fusekit + synckit + ccp and cut fresh releases (ccn/native task tracked). See [[claude-pool-project]], [[claude-tokenless-tombstone-chain]].
